note: All four shots are genuine Playwright renders of the running app or of PNGs the app itself exported. No mock-ups: the cover shot is the app's own 1080x1350 export, and the export shot is the app's own 1920x1080 export, each scaled to fit the capture limits.

shots.shows: The app's own 1080x1350 PNG export of the default Ensemble Poster — ten panels with THE RIDER, a real garage photograph of a weathered cruiser, stretched wide beneath the hero portrait — scaled to 1024x1280 and finished with the shared sharpen pass.
shots.title: The ensemble cover with THE RIDER, exported by the app

shots.shows: The full studio workspace: live preview of the Ensemble Poster beside the poster, words, panels, sample-strip and recipe controls.
shots.title: The editor with the ensemble cover loaded

shots.shows: The editor after switching layouts and colour grades through its own controls, proving the layouts, grades and recipes are live features rather than fixed artwork.
shots.title: Another layout and grade, chosen in the real UI

shots.shows: The app's own 1920x1080 PNG export displayed scaled to fit, showing the same renderer driving the landscape format.
shots.title: The wide export, produced by the app
